senses.definition: The place in code or a container where a program starts running.
senses.caution: Say which one you mean: a program's main function, a container's startup command, or a package's command. The word alone is vague.
senses.example: The container's entrypoint is a shell script that sets up the environment and then starts the server.

cues.text: A Dockerfile has a line that sets the command that runs when the container starts. You want the name of that setting.
A new engineer asks which file to open first to follow what the program does, and you show them the place where execution begins.
A web framework is configured with the single function it calls first when the app launches. You need the one-word name for it.

distractors: A file that lists the libraries a project depends on and the versions it needs.
A place where a program saves its errors so that someone can read them later.
A copy of the program kept in case the first one is lost.
The last step of a build, after all the tests have passed.
A set of rules about who is allowed to open a file.
